question: In 1850, Kashmir was sold under which of the following treaties to the Dogra dynasty of Jammu?
solution:
The correct answer is **Treaty of Amritsar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kashmir** was sold to the Dogra dynasty of Jammu under the **Treaty of Amritsar** in 1846.
 
• The treaty was signed between the British East India Company and **Maharaja Gulab Singh** of Jammu.
 
• The British sold Kashmir for a sum of **7.5 million Nanakshahee rupees**.
 
• The treaty effectively established the **Dogra rule** over the region of Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Key Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Treaty of Amritsar**
 The treaty signed in 1846 that transferred the territories of Jammu and Kashmir to Maharaja Gulab Singh.
 
 

 **Maharaja Gulab Singh**
 The founder of the Dogra dynasty and the first Maharaja of the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 

 **Dogra Dynasty**
 A Rajput dynasty that ruled Jammu and Kashmir from 1846 to 1947.
 
 

 **Nanakshahee Rupees**
 The currency used during the time of the Sikh Empire and later by the Dogra rulers.
